blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Это упрощает ___ (наша задача).
exercises.why: The direct object of «упрощать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You broke the washing machine.
exercises.why: The direct object of «сломать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Газета опубликовала ___ (уморительная пародия) на речь президента.
exercises.prompt: The newspaper published a hilarious parody of the president's speech.
exercises.why: The direct object of «опубликовать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom and Mary decorated the Christmas tree.
exercises.why: The direct object of «нарядить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Интерьер дома создаёт ___ (иллюзия) простора и роскоши.
exercises.prompt: The interior of the house creates the illusion of roominess and luxury.
exercises.why: The direct object of «создавать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It is impossible for me to finish my term paper by tomorrow.
exercises.ru: Просто невозможно доделать ___ к завтрашнему дню!
exercises.why: The direct object of «доделать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Смола не отходит. Мне придется отнести ___ (эта юбка) в химчистку.
exercises.prompt: The tar won't come off. I'm going to have to take this skirt to the dry cleaner.
exercises.why: The direct object of «отнести»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Many transgender people experience gender dysphoria.
exercises.why: The direct object of «испытывать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я провела ___ (неделя) с палестинской семьей из Газы.
exercises.prompt: I spent a week with a Palestinian family from Gaza.
exercises.why: The direct object of «провести»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom has begun writing a cookbook.
exercises.why: The direct object of «писать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я люблю ___ (броская одежда).
exercises.why: The direct object of «любить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You really do tap dance quite well.
exercises.why: The direct object of «бить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы должны восполнить ___ (потеря).
exercises.prompt: We must make up for the loss.
exercises.why: The direct object of «восполнить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You can sing a song.
exercises.why: The direct object of «спеть»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Поздравляю, Вы выиграли ___ (вафельница)!
exercises.prompt: Congratulations! You've won a waffle iron!
exercises.why: The direct object of «выиграть»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I don't drive often.
exercises.why: The direct object of «возить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я направил ___ (своя камера) на неё.
exercises.prompt: I pointed my camera at her.
exercises.why: The direct object of «направить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The sun baked the ground dry.
exercises.why: The direct object of «высушить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Все ли обожают ___ (музыка)?
exercises.why: The direct object of «обожать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom licked the spoon clean.
exercises.why: The direct object of «облизать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
